verdict.rationale: Unity documents an official MCP server that connects LLM agents such as Claude Code and Cursor to the Unity Editor via the com.unity.ai.assistant package, linked from unity.com/features/ai and included on the Personal plan. Newer docs deprecate that in-editor server in favor of the first-party Unity CLI's fully supported `unity mcp` server mode. The setup is in flux, though: the CLI is experimental, the AI tools are beta and metered via Unity Credits, and distribution is closed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of a working MCP handshake (no public repo, and no keyless handshake possible), and a stable non-beta/non-experimental MCP offering.
